text_simplified: Parents should avoid praying against their children in moments of intense anger and emotion, for fear that the prayer may coincide with an hour of acceptance and the parent may regret it for the rest of their life. Allah the Exalted has informed us about man's haste in praying for evil just as he prays for good. Qatadah and Ibn Sa'di (may Allah have mercy on them) explained that this includes a person's praying against his child and wealth when angry, but Allah in His kindness does not hasten the response of evil for people.
